adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` compute a fallback calendar ID as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When the ternary takes the fallback branch, `externalCalendarId` is falsy (likely `undefined`/`null`), so the `.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` comparison can never match any real `externalId`, yielding `undefined` and effectively making the fallback dead/unusable (same issue in the later `calendarId` computation). This is a correctness issue introduced by the diff.
